{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_capital_run_total",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total length of uninterrupted sequences of capital letters.",
      "value_range": [0.69, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the scale of capital run length total, reducing the impact of extreme outliers on Euclidean distance calculations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total capital run length to the longest capital run length.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 1000.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the distribution of capital letters, providing a scale-invariant structural feature that improves neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "capital_run_length_total / np.maximum(capital_run_length_longest, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "total_char_freq_symbols",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all character frequencies (symbols).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates symbol frequencies to create a dense, scale-comparable feature for distance calculation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_variance_word_intensity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed sum of selected high-variance word frequencies.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Groups high-variance word frequencies into a single normalized dimension, reducing noise in distance metrics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_24 + word_freq_26)"
    },
    {
      "name": "is_high_capital_run",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator for whether the average capital run length exceeds 5.0.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a binary indicator for clustering, partitioning the space into high and low capitalization regions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_run_length_average > 5.0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "word_freq_dominance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum frequency among a subset of highly variable words.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_feature",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Extracts the maximum frequency among highly variable words, acting as a prototype-like feature for extreme values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(word_freq_1, np.maximum(word_freq_11, word_freq_18))"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_freq_3_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Clipped and scaled version of char_freq_3.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounds and scales a highly skewed character frequency, preventing it from dominating the distance metric.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(char_freq_3, 0.0, 5.0) / 5.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_longest_to_total_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of the longest capital run to the total capital run length.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded [0,1] ratio representing the concentration of capital letters in a single run, ideal for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "capital_run_length_longest / np.maximum(capital_run_length_total, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_urgency_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "A semantic assessment of the text's urgency or call-to-action intensity, based on the combination of word frequencies and exclamation/symbol usage.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_embedding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Embeds complex semantic meaning into a single continuous dimension, enriching the neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "structural_complexity_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "An evaluation of the document's structural complexity, considering the interplay between average capital run lengths, total length, and symbol diversity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_embedding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic structural metric that helps KNN distinguish between simple and complex document layouts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "prototype_distance_origin",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of the first five word frequencies, representing distance from the origin in a specific subspace.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Computes the L2 norm of a subset of features, acting as an unsupervised distance to the origin to help structure the space.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(word_freq_0**2 + word_freq_1**2 + word_freq_2**2 + word_freq_3**2 + word_freq_4**2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "symbol_to_word_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total symbol frequencies to the sum of the first five word frequencies.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 500.0],
      "feature_family": "structural_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the relative density of symbols to common words, offering a scale-invariant ratio for similarity search.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5) / np.maximum(word_freq_0 + word_freq_1 + word_freq_2 + word_freq_3 + word_freq_4, 0.1)"
    }
  ]
}
